title: Retire a storage unit, rack, shelf or box
purpose: Take a storage unit, rack, shelf, tower, canister or box out of service permanently, keeping its record, code and history.

sections.title: Who and when
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.

Retirement is permanent: a retired record cannot be reactivated, edited, moved or offered for storage. Its positions stop counting as capacity. Nothing is deleted, disposed of or reused; the code can never be reused. Already-retired records return to their page with a message.

items.label: Storage unit
items.description: Allowed only when none of its racks, towers, shelves or canisters is active.

items.label: Rack, tower, shelf or canister
items.description: Allowed only when it holds no active child nodes or boxes.

items.label: Box
items.description: Allowed only when no item is stored in it.

items.label: Reason for retirement
items.description: Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history, and shown on the retired record's banner.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: If the record changed since you opened the form the retirement is refused with a message to reload. The button is available on the record's page only when its rule is met; the service checks again at submission.

items.label: Retire ...
items.description: Retires the record and returns to it.
